title: Parent–Teacher Meeting
description: Class-wise meetings with subject teachers. Quarterly report cards are handed over in person.

title: Deepavali Celebration
description: Cultural programmes by students, followed by sweets distribution. Students may wear traditional dress.

title: Inter-House Sports Meet
description: Track and field events for classes 6 to 10. Parents are welcome to attend and cheer.

title: Science Exhibition
description: Students present working models and charts. Judged by teachers from neighbouring schools.

title: Annual Day
description: The school’s flagship celebration — dance, drama, prize distribution and the Chief Guest’s address.
